title: NetworkMachineManageResult
description: network.machine-manage-result@1: the machine as it is after a change (plan L34, step M2: PATCH /api/v1/machines/:id, PUT /api/v1/machines/:id/roles, POST /api/v1/machines/:id/revoke). The pairing route answers network.machine-pairing@1 instead, because a pairing is a code and not a machine.
